first_name / last_name: at least one letter, no digits
not a placeholder (e.g. test, n/a, unknown, a repeated header)
failing any of these rejects the row (status invalid_input, flag input.rejected)
email: otherwise dropped with note input.email_invalid; the row continues
linkedin_url: linkedin.com/in/<slug> or /pub/<slug>, any scheme, www or regional subdomain
canonicalised; otherwise dropped with note input.linkedin_url_invalid
company / location: not a placeholder such as self-employed, student, n/a
consent: yes/no spellings: 1, agree, agreed, consented, granted, ok, opt in, opted in, optin, true, y, yes | 0, decline, declined, false, n, no, none, opt out, opted out, optout, refused, withheld
an explicit no rejects the row (consent: withheld)
with require_consent on, a missing or unrecognised answer rejects the row too

rejected_when: no header, or first_name/last_name missing from the header
not text (NUL bytes) or above max_bytes
a header but no data rows, or every data row rejected
warned_when: fewer than 20% of valid rows matched

outputs.rejected_files: quarantine/files/<timestamp>-<name> with the reason as object metadata
